title: Repair Linux Vulkan reference and repeatability correctness
requires: Physical ThomasLaptop RTX 3050 Ti Vulkan target with pinned validation SDK
scope: Repair the F8-87 Linux Vulkan exit blocker: all 30 public cases retain 5,941 frozen-reference differences with numerical or invariant failures, while cloth-water, rope-fluid and rope-soft-body fail fresh plain-run repeatability. Preserve the sole schedule, shared Slang equations and immutable candidate-v10 failure record.
acceptance: Reproduce all 30 public-reference failures and all three repeatability failures with exact installed source, Vulkan driver, SDK, GPU, validation and manifest identities.

Locate the first nondeterministic or cross-reference divergence with state, dispatch, barrier and ownership evidence. Repair synchronization, initialization, resource or shared-kernel causes without weakening tolerances or hiding validation messages.
Pass all 30 public cases in plain and validation modes, repeated-run comparisons, 49 capability obligations, 12 physical scenarios, five negative controls and lifecycle/recovery assertions.
Preserve the one-step schedule, single spatial epoch and independent solver-work limits. Retain every workload timing sample and stall while keeping timing verdicts separate.
Pass installed SDK relocation and Gallery checks and publish complete before/after evidence.
